item.title: MTN locks in 12-month pay protection for IHS staff ahead of takeover
item.description: As MTN Group moves closer to finalising its takeover of IHS Holding Limited, it has offered employees a measure of certainty: at least 12 months of guaranteed pay and core benefits following the deal’s completion.

item.title: Microsoft says AI could add $136 billion to Africa if data can move freely
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) could add as much as $136 billion in productivity gains across Africa, according to Microsoft. Unlocking that value, however, depends on whether countries can enable the secure, seamless flow of data across their borders.

item.title: Fintech still dominates Africa’s VC. Deeptech may be next.
item.description: Africa's VC funding remains concentrated in fintech and in four markets: South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, and Egypt. Deeptech’s share is rising, but from a small base.

item.title: Nairobi Securities Exchange plans dedicated tech board to lure startups
item.description: NSE chief listing officer Gift Kori said the bourse was actively exploring a specialised tech segment that would sit under its existing market structure but be tailored to high-growth, early-stage companies across the continent.

item.title: Airtel Africa in late-stage Starlink talks to close rural coverage gaps
item.description: Airtel is in late-stage discussions with SpaceX to integrate Starlink’s direct-to-cell technology into its network, according to Airtel Africa's chief executive Sunil Taldar.

item.title: Risevest secures SEC licence in major regulatory turnaround
item.description: Risevest has acquired a Fund & Portfolio Manager licence through its new subsidiary, RV Fund Management Limited.

item.title: Five apps helping Muslims navigate Ramadan in a digital age
item.description: Here are five apps that Muslims around the world are using to navigate Ramadan this year.

item.title: From Egypt to Gabon: 33 African countries that have imposed social media bans
item.description: At some point, about 34 African countries have imposed a social media ban or a full internet shutdown that disrupted social media access.

item.title: Nigeria’s busiest airports to get MTN-backed free Wi-Fi
item.description: Travellers passing through Nigeria’s major international airports will now enjoy one hour of free high-speed internet, following a new partnership between the Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria (FAAN) and MTN Nigeria, the country’s biggest telco.
